references.text: God promises Abraham a son through Sarah. The promise in Gen 18:10 confirms and repeats this earlier promise.
The promise is repeated with the same expression 'at the appointed time' (כָּעֵת חַיָּה), confirming that Sarah will give birth to a son.
The fulfillment of the promise that Sarah would conceive and bear a son to Abraham at the appointed time.
Elisha's promise to the Shunammite woman uses almost identical wording (כָּעֵת חַיָּה) about having a son.
Paul mentions Abraham's faith in God's promise of a son, linked to the promise given in Gen 18:10.
Paul quotes directly from Gen 18:10 regarding the promise: 'At this time I will return, and Sarah shall have a son.'
Hebrews mentions Sarah's faith as the basis for her conceiving a son despite her old age, as fulfillment of the promise.
